plan.title: Liver drug treatment vs control: DESeq2 DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: 3 treated vs 3 control liver samples, raw STAR/featureCounts integer gene counts, single batch, unpaired. The procedure follows the grounded DESeq2 two-group workflow: QC on sample structure first (to catch a mis-clustering sample before the test spends power on it), minimal count pre-filtering, DESeq2's internal median-of-ratios normalization (no external normalization of raw counts, per rule R-0026), a Wald test with an explicit control reference level, apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control coefficient, BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05, and a second differential-expression path with edgeR quasi-likelihood for a robustness cross-check (rule R-0001/R-0042) given the low replicate number (n=3/group triggers the low-power flag R-0017). Enrichment runs fgsea preranked on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (available in refs) then Reactome (available in refs) as the named follow-up collection. The final report consolidates DE tables, diagnostic plots, the DESeq2/edgeR overlap, and the enrichment results with the mandated reproducibility record and power caveat for a 3-vs-3 design.
